interpretation.cad_disagreement: CAD disagreement combines nominal CAD geometry, physical installation, export/padding choices, and vision-calibration effects. It is not calibration error because physical installation is unsurveyed.
interpretation.detection_consistency: Detection consistency scores held-out marker corner prediction from other visible markers. It does not claim absolute pose accuracy.
interpretation.held_out_declaration: Held-out status is declared in the manifest and preserved here; the tool does not independently verify that videos were excluded from calibration.
interpretation.no_overall_winner: Geometry and detection rankings are reported separately and may disagree.
